title: Fix misleading PDF generation errors and add robust pre-validation for product fields

requirements.text: Improve PDF-step error handling so the UI shows an accurate, actionable message based on the real underlying PDF error (e.g., missing jsPDF CDN library vs. missing/invalid product fields), instead of always prompting to verify name/subtitle/description.

quotes: Failed to generate PDF for "Digital Planner Mastery" (Product 1). Please verify that the product name, subtitle, and description are filled in and try again.

acceptanceCriteria: When jsPDF is not available (e.g., getJsPDF() throws "jsPDF library not loaded"), the displayed error explicitly indicates jsPDF failed to load and suggests retrying after ensuring the library is available.
When product fields are missing/blank, the displayed error explicitly lists which fields are missing (name, subtitle, description) for the affected product.
The error message shown for PDF failures is derived from the underlying error (GenerationError.originalError) and is not a generic/incorrect prompt.

requirements.text: Add pre-validation before attempting PDF generation for each product to ensure required fields are present and non-empty (after trimming), and prevent generation when validation fails.

quotes: Please verify that the product name, subtitle, and description are filled in and try again.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Generate” for a product with missing/blank name, subtitle, or description does not call the PDF generator and instead shows a clear validation error in English.
Clicking “Generate All Products” skips/blocks generation if any product has missing required fields and reports which product(s) need fixes.
Validation uses trimmed strings (e.g., whitespace-only values are treated as missing).

requirements.text: Harden the PDF generator against undefined/empty text inputs by safely normalizing product fields to strings and guarding jsPDF text calls so generation does not crash due to unexpected undefined/null values coming from drafts or merges.

quotes: Failed to generate PDF for "Digital Planner Mastery" (Product 1).

acceptanceCriteria: If any of product.name/product.subtitle/product.description is unexpectedly undefined/null at runtime, PDF generation fails with a clear, accurate error indicating invalid product data (not a generic message), and logs useful diagnostics via existing logging.
No jsPDF doc.text invocation receives a non-string value (verified by code changes and manual testing through the UI).

constraints: Do not modify read-only frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Redesigning the PDF layout/content beyond what is necessary to prevent errors and improve error messaging.
Adding new authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding external databases or third-party backend services.
